mapper.select: SELECT A.* , ROWNUM FROM ( SELECT u_member_id, u_id, u_name, u_address, u_email, u_birthday, u_nickname, u_regdate FROM user_tbl ORDER BY u_regdate DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_tbl b JOIN user_tbl u ON u.u_member_id = b.u_member_id WHERE 1=1
AND b.b_category = #{category}
AND b.b_dateposted >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND b.b_dateposted < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ( b.b_title LIKE '%'||#{q}||'%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(b.b_contents, #{q}) > 0 OR u.u_nickname LIKE '%'||#{q}||'%' )
